name: SPC barcoding and capsule handling (stage B)
description: DEMO SCALE (0.192 of the original 150 x 100 mm). STAGE A HAS BEEN RETIRED: its flow-focusing encapsulator duplicated spc_demo_v1, which is the only encapsulation geometry we can actually fabricate, and it was also what made this chip impossible to build - flow focusing needs shell, core, oil and an outlet simultaneously, which with stage B pushed the chip to 13 ports against a limit of 6. What remains is stage B: capsule packing, emulsion breaking and the wash trap. Capsules arrive already made from spc_demo_v1. Sequential inlets share in_reagent and in_load behind off-chip selector valves. The trap's retention opening cannot be printed in plane (200 um floor against a 70 um capsule) and must be a depth weir or a bought mesh - see contracts/blocks.json. The authoritative weir there is a 272 um crest leaving a 28 um gap in a 300 um layer (retains about 70 um capsules), UNTESTED, with the z tolerance (about +/-20 um on a 28 um gap) the biggest unknown. This chip is only 0.15 mm deep, so a 272 um crest does not fit and trap_1 is deliberately given no structured weir object: it relies on packed-bed geometry and gravity (see its note), or a bought mesh insert. Stage B was re-laid out after scaling: at 30 x 20 mm the original 150 x 100 mm routing crossed itself in eight places, and in a single-layer chip a crossing is a short circuit, so chambers and ports were re-placed until the plan is crossing-free.

chambers.note: Close-packed re-injection entrance, 115 um wide against a 135 um capsule (0.85 x d). This ratio is what beats Poisson on the capsule: published work gets 93-97% single occupancy this way. It is also the reason the capsules are 135 um and not 70 um.
Second flow-focusing cross, 150 um orifice, cuts one capsule plus its barcode back into oil.

Phase separation. A row of 100 x 150 um slots on a 300 um pitch, wetted for the aqueous phase; oil leaves through the separate hydrophobic line to out_oil. This is the step the bench protocol loses the most capsules at, so it is the main thing the chip is for.

Packed-bed trap replacing ~20 centrifugation steps. Retention is by chamber geometry and gravity with downward flow, NOT by a size gap: a liquid-core capsule deforms, and the gap that would reliably hold a 135 um capsule is ~0.5-0.6 x d = 70-80 um, which we cannot make. Buffer exchange is diffusion-limited at ~2-5 min, not flush-limited.

ports.note: off-chip selector valve: shell polymer (stage A, to filt_shell) / amplification mix + single-copy barcode (stage B, to pack_1) / wash and reagent buffers (stage C, to trap_1). Merged from in_shell, in_mix, in_wash.
off-chip selector valve: oil waste, aqueous waste below the bed, and back-flushed capsule recovery. Merged from out_oil, out_waste, out_recover.
off-chip selector valve: cured capsules, close-packed (stage B, to pack_1) / thermocycled emulsion back from the tube (stage C, to brk_1). Merged from in_caps, in_emul.
one capsule per droplet, to the thermocycler
carrier oil for both nozzles. Merged from in_oil1, in_oil2.
